name: SEIZE 😂
desc:
😍 Welcome to S.E.I.Z.E collect scraps to meet your quota, but beware... you're not alone Lurking in the shadows are terrifying monsters🪿

🎮 PC CONTROLS 

Shift to Run
Ctrl to Crouch
Q to Tiny 
MOUSE1 to Grab Item/Open Doors
